import numpy as np
r=-dA_dt
for lo,hi in [(0.5,0.8),(1.0,1.5),(2.5,3.5),(4.5,5.5),(7.5,8.5),(9.2,10)]:
    m=(t>lo)&(t<hi)
    o=np.argsort(A[m])
    a=A[m][o]; rr=r[m][o]
    p=np.polyfit(np.log(a),np.log(rr),1)
    p2=np.polyfit(a,rr,2)
    print(lo,hi,m.sum(),'loglog slope',np.round(p,3),'quad resid', np.round(np.std(rr-np.polyval(p2,a)),3), 'rel', np.round(np.std(np.log(rr)-np.polyval(p,np.log(a))),3))
    print(np.round(np.c_[a,rr][::max(1,m.sum()//6)],3).tolist())
